package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const (
	PluginName        = "BeeNT Go 验收插件"
	PluginAuthor      = "SDK"
	PluginVersion     = "1.0.1"
	PluginDescription = "真实 BeeNT 手动验收：/beent help、ping、echo 原文、info、id、quote、recall、event on/off、bg 原文、data、intercept。仅收到命令后回复，日志保存在插件数据目录。"
)

const acceptanceHelp = "BeeNT Go 验收命令\n/beent ping → PONG\n/beent echo <原文> → 原文（支持多行和emoji）\n/beent info → 框架和机器人信息\n/beent id → 本次消息全部参数\n/beent quote → 引用本次消息\n/beent recall → 只撤回本来源最近一条插件测试回复\n/beent event on|off → 事件通知订阅/退订（默认关闭）\n/beent bg [原文] → 2秒后回本来源（禁用取消）\n/beent data → 持久计数加1\n/beent intercept → 回复并返回拦截1\n日志：acceptance.log；状态：acceptance_state.json"

type acceptanceTarget struct {
	group bool
	id    string
}

func (t acceptanceTarget) key() string {
	if t.group {
		return "group:" + t.id
	}
	return "friend:" + t.id
}
func (t acceptanceTarget) kind() string {
	if t.group {
		return "group"
	}
	return "friend"
}

type acceptancePlugin struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	logMu       sync.Mutex
	dir         string
	factory     func() (*BeeNTAPI, error)
	ctx         context.Context
	cancel      context.CancelFunc
	wg          sync.WaitGroup
	enabled     bool
	selfQQ      string
	last        map[string]string
	subscribers map[string]acceptanceTarget
	count       uint64
}

func newAcceptancePlugin(dataDir string, factory func() (*BeeNTAPI, error)) *acceptancePlugin {
	return &acceptancePlugin{dir: dataDir, factory: factory, last: make(map[string]string), subscribers: make(map[string]acceptanceTarget)}
}

var acceptanceRuntime = newAcceptancePlugin("", NewBeeNTAPI)

// The transport decorator records raw responses even when a typed parser
// rejects them, so acceptance.log distinguishes host business errors from IPC.
type acceptanceLoggingTransport struct {
	inner  APITransport
	plugin *acceptancePlugin
}

func (t *acceptanceLoggingTransport) Call(command []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	result, err := t.inner.Call(command)
	entry := map[string]any{"command": string(command), "result": string(result), "error": ""}
	if err != nil {
		entry["error"] = err.Error()
	}
	t.plugin.record("api", entry)
	return result, err
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) api() (*BeeNTAPI, error) {
	api, err := p.factory()
	if err != nil {
		p.record("api_connection_error", map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
		return nil, err
	}
	return NewBeeNTAPIWithTransport(api.index, &acceptanceLoggingTransport{inner: api.transport, plugin: p})
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) record(kind string, fields map[string]any) {
	entry := make(map[string]any, len(fields)+2)
	entry["time"] = time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	entry["kind"] = kind
	for key, value := range fields {
		entry[key] = value
	}
	line, err := json.Marshal(entry)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "acceptance log encoding:", err)
		return
	}
	p.logMu.Lock()
	defer p.logMu.Unlock()
	if p.dir == "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, string(line))
		return
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(p.dir, "acceptance.log"), os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0644)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "acceptance log:", err)
		return
	}
	_, err = f.Write(append(line, '\n'))
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if err == nil {
		err = closeErr
	}
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "acceptance log:", err)
	}
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) initialize() {
	if p.dir == "" {
		dir, err := GetAppDataDir()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "acceptance data directory:", err)
			return
		}
		p.dir = dir
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(p.dir, 0755); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "acceptance data directory:", err)
		return
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(p.dir, "acceptance_state.json"))
	if err == nil {
		var state struct {
			Count uint64 `json:"count"`
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &state); err == nil {
			p.mu.Lock()
			p.count = state.Count
			p.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		p.record("state_read_error", map[string]any{"error": err.Error()})
	}
	p.record("initialize", map[string]any{"data_dir": p.dir, "plugin": PluginName, "version": PluginVersion, "go_version": runtime.Version()})
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) enable() {
	p.stopTasks()
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.ctx, p.cancel = context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	p.enabled = true
	p.mu.Unlock()
	api, err := p.api()
	if err == nil {
		qq, callErr := api.GetFrameworkQQ()
		if callErr == nil {
			p.mu.Lock()
			p.selfQQ = qq
			p.mu.Unlock()
		} else {
			err = callErr
		}
	}
	entry := map[string]any{"self_qq": p.selfQQ, "error": ""}
	if err != nil {
		entry["error"] = err.Error()
	}
	p.record("enable", entry)
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) stopTasks() {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.enabled = false
	if p.cancel != nil {
		p.cancel()
		p.cancel = nil
	}
	p.subscribers = make(map[string]acceptanceTarget)
	p.mu.Unlock()
	p.wg.Wait()
}
func (p *acceptancePlugin) disable() {
	p.stopTasks()
	closeSettingsWindow()
	p.record("disable", map[string]any{})
}
func (p *acceptancePlugin) unload() {
	p.stopTasks()
	closeSettingsWindow()
	p.record("unload", map[string]any{})
}
func (p *acceptancePlugin) settings() { p.record("settings", map[string]any{}); showSettingsWindow() }

func (p *acceptancePlugin) send(api *BeeNTAPI, target acceptanceTarget, content string) {
	var result string
	var err error
	if target.group {
		result, err = api.Group(target.id).SendText(content)
	} else {
		result, err = api.Friend(target.id).SendText(content)
	}
	// Framework message IDs are decimal text. An arbitrary failure reason must
	// never become a RecallMessage argument.
	if err == nil && acceptanceMessageID(result) {
		p.mu.Lock()
		p.last[target.key()] = result
		p.mu.Unlock()
	}
	if err != nil {
		p.record("reply_error", map[string]any{"target": target.key(), "error": err.Error()})
	}
}

func acceptanceMessageID(value string) bool {
	if value == "" {
		return false
	}
	digits := value
	if digits[0] == '-' {
		digits = digits[1:]
	}
	if digits == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, ch := range digits {
		if ch < '0' || ch > '9' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) message(group bool, sourceID, userID, message, messageID string) int {
	if message != "/beent" && !strings.HasPrefix(message, "/beent ") {
		return MessageContinue
	}
	p.mu.Lock()
	self, enabled := p.selfQQ, p.enabled
	p.mu.Unlock()
	if !enabled || (self != "" && userID == self) {
		return MessageContinue
	}
	target := acceptanceTarget{group: group, id: sourceID}
	p.record("request", map[string]any{"source": target.key(), "user_id": userID, "message_id": messageID, "message": message})
	api, err := p.api()
	if err != nil {
		return MessageContinue
	}
	command, body := "help", ""
	if message != "/beent" {
		rest := strings.TrimPrefix(message, "/beent ")
		parts := strings.SplitN(rest, " ", 2)
		command = parts[0]
		if len(parts) == 2 {
			body = parts[1]
		}
	}
	switch command {
	case "help":
		p.send(api, target, acceptanceHelp)
	case "ping":
		p.send(api, target, "PONG")
	case "echo":
		if body == "" {
			p.send(api, target, "用法: /beent echo <原文>")
		} else {
			p.send(api, target, body)
		}
	case "info":
		fields := map[string]any{}
		issues := map[string]string{}
		name, e := api.GetFrameworkName()
		fields["framework_name"] = name
		if e != nil {
			issues["framework_name"] = e.Error()
		}
		version, e := api.GetFrameworkVersion()
		fields["framework_version"] = version
		if e != nil {
			issues["framework_version"] = e.Error()
		}
		qq, e := api.GetFrameworkQQ()
		fields["framework_qq"] = qq
		if e != nil {
			issues["framework_qq"] = e.Error()
		}
		robot, e := api.GetRobotInfo()
		fields["robot_info"] = robot
		if e != nil {
			issues["robot_info"] = e.Error()
		}
		fields["errors"] = issues
		p.send(api, target, "框架信息: "+acceptanceJSON(fields))
	case "id":
		p.send(api, target, "消息参数: "+acceptanceJSON(map[string]any{"kind": target.kind(), "source_id": sourceID, "user_id": userID, "message_id": messageID, "message": message}))
	case "quote":
		var result string
		if target.group {
			result, err = api.Group(sourceID).Reply(messageID, "BeeNT Go 引用测试")
		} else {
			result, err = api.Friend(sourceID).Reply(messageID, "BeeNT Go 引用测试")
		}
		if err == nil && acceptanceMessageID(result) {
			p.mu.Lock()
			p.last[target.key()] = result
			p.mu.Unlock()
		}
		if err != nil {
			p.send(api, target, "引用调用错误: "+err.Error())
		}
	case "recall":
		p.mu.Lock()
		id := p.last[target.key()]
		delete(p.last, target.key())
		p.mu.Unlock()
		if !acceptanceMessageID(id) {
			p.send(api, target, "没有可撤回的插件测试消息")
			break
		}
		result, e := api.RecallMessage(id)
		if e != nil {
			p.send(api, target, "撤回调用错误: "+e.Error())
		} else {
			p.send(api, target, "撤回结果: "+result)
		}
	case "event":
		if body != "on" && body != "off" {
			p.send(api, target, "用法: /beent event on|off")
			break
		}
		p.mu.Lock()
		if body == "on" {
			p.subscribers[target.key()] = target
		} else {
			delete(p.subscribers, target.key())
		}
		p.mu.Unlock()
		p.record("event_subscription", map[string]any{"target": target.key(), "state": body})
		p.send(api, target, "事件通知已"+map[string]string{"on": "开启", "off": "关闭"}[body])
	case "bg":
		if body == "" {
			body = "BG DONE"
		}
		p.send(api, target, "后台任务已安排（2秒后回复）")
		p.background(target, body)
	case "data":
		count, e := p.incrementData()
		if e != nil {
			p.send(api, target, "持久化错误: "+e.Error())
		} else {
			p.send(api, target, "持久计数: "+strconv.FormatUint(count, 10)+"\n目录: "+p.dir)
		}
	case "intercept":
		p.send(api, target, "本条命令返回拦截 1；其他命令默认继续 0")
		p.record("intercept", map[string]any{"message_id": messageID, "result": 1})
		return MessageIntercept
	default:
		p.send(api, target, "未知验收命令；发送 /beent help 查看操作表")
	}
	return MessageContinue
}

func acceptanceJSON(value any) string {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err.Error()
	}
	return string(raw)
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) incrementData() (uint64, error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	next := p.count + 1
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]uint64{"count": next}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	path := filepath.Join(p.dir, "acceptance_state.json")
	temporary := path + ".tmp"
	if err = os.WriteFile(temporary, append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err = os.Rename(temporary, path); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	p.count = next
	return next, nil
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) background(target acceptanceTarget, content string) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	if !p.enabled || p.ctx == nil {
		p.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	ctx := p.ctx
	p.wg.Add(1)
	p.mu.Unlock()
	go func() {
		defer p.wg.Done()
		timer := time.NewTimer(2 * time.Second)
		defer timer.Stop()
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			p.record("background_cancelled", map[string]any{"target": target.key()})
			return
		case <-timer.C:
		}
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			p.record("background_cancelled", map[string]any{"target": target.key()})
			return
		}
		api, err := p.api()
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		p.send(api, target, content)
		p.record("background_complete", map[string]any{"target": target.key(), "content": content})
	}()
}

func (p *acceptancePlugin) event(eventType, sourceID, userNickname, userID, operatorNickname, operatorID, message, flag string) int {
	fields := []string{eventType, sourceID, userNickname, userID, operatorNickname, operatorID, message, flag}
	p.record("event", map[string]any{"fields": fields, "event_type": eventType, "source_id": sourceID, "user_nickname": userNickname, "user_id": userID, "operator_nickname": operatorNickname, "operator_id": operatorID, "message": message, "flag": flag})
	p.mu.Lock()
	targets := make([]acceptanceTarget, 0, len(p.subscribers))
	if p.enabled {
		for _, target := range p.subscribers {
			targets = append(targets, target)
		}
	}
	p.mu.Unlock()
	if len(targets) > 0 {
		api, err := p.api()
		if err == nil {
			for _, target := range targets {
				p.send(api, target, "事件原始八字段: "+acceptanceJSON(fields))
			}
		}
	}
	return MessageContinue
}

func onInitialize() { acceptanceRuntime.initialize() }
func onEnable()     { acceptanceRuntime.enable() }
func onDisable()    { acceptanceRuntime.disable() }
func onUnload()     { acceptanceRuntime.unload() }
func onSettings()   { acceptanceRuntime.settings() }
func onPrivateMessage(friendID, message, messageID string) int {
	return acceptanceRuntime.message(false, friendID, friendID, message, messageID)
}
func onGroupMessage(groupID, userID, message, messageID string) int {
	return acceptanceRuntime.message(true, groupID, userID, message, messageID)
}
func onEvent(eventType, sourceID, userNickname, userID, operatorNickname, operatorID, message, flag string) int {
	return acceptanceRuntime.event(eventType, sourceID, userNickname, userID, operatorNickname, operatorID, message, flag)
}
